chunks: Abu 'Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from some of his companions, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام: regarding...

Concerning a man against whom clear proof was established that he had committed zina, then he fled before the punishment was carried out, he said: "If he repents, then nothing remains upon him; but if he falls into the hand of the Imam, he will carry out the hadd upon him. And if he knows his location, he sends for him."

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the legitimate authority who enforces the law
key_terms.الْبَيِّنَةُ: clear legal proof or evidentiary testimony
key_terms.تَابَ: repented and turned back from the sin

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a person proven guilty of zina escapes before the hadd punishment is carried out?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person proven to have committed zina who flees before the hadd is enforced. It indicates that if he repents, nothing remains upon him, but if the Imam apprehends him, the hadd is to be carried out, and if his location is known, he is to be summoned or pursued.
